evidence.status: direct local contradictions plus bounded methodological migration

purpose: Replace future-fold selection and invalid raw-row chunk inference with issuance-day past-only comparison and one joint dependent-resampling family protocol.

invariants.P1: operating day is (forecast_kst_dtm - 1h).normalize; every complete atom has 3x24=72 unique cells
invariants.P2: outer selection/fit timestamps are strictly earlier than each test issuance; future folds never select past folds
invariants.P3: daily additive loss sums to 0.5 - exact official Total within 1e-12
invariants.P4: stationary bootstrap restarts geometrically and preserves chronological fold lengths; fixed nonoverlapping chunks are forbidden
invariants.P5: all frozen candidates use the same joint bootstrap draws and one complete family
invariants.P6: score-bearing evaluation requires the next EventStore comparison_index, never a per-node reset
invariants.P7: report centered joint max-t simultaneous lower bounds and 90% T_R model-confidence set without posterior language
invariants.P8: primary expected block length 7 days plus fixed sensitivities 3 and 14
invariants.P9: additive-daily and resampled-exact-Total conclusions must agree or inference is INSUFFICIENT
invariants.P11: legacy arbiter fails closed for promotion calls
